evidence.reason: The dedupe path reuses an existing content-addressed target solely on path existence, even though the new manifest and artifact hashes are computed. If an earlier target's untracked.tar was truncated after its manifest was written, an unchanged worktree produces the same token; the intact new capture is discarded and the damaged target is returned as success. This is a concrete data-integrity defect in existing retain behavior, not merely a new protection requirement.
